categories.title: Bounty Poster
categories.info: Check inside jails, police stations, and sheriff offices for posters of wanted criminals in the area.

categories.title: Cigarette Card
categories.info:
Decorative cards found in the open world or inside purchased Premium Cigarette packs. Duplicate cards can be sold to fences.

Complete each of the twelve card sets for additional rewards.

categories.title: Dinosaur Bone
categories.info: Help [Deborah MacGuiness](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=50) with her paleontological research by mailing the locations of dinosaur bones.

categories.title: Dreamcatcher
categories.info:
Keep an eye out for intricately woven ornaments hanging from tree branches.

Find all Dreamcatchers to reveal a clue on the map that points to a [secret treasure!](https://rdr2map.com?locationIds=5383.)

categories.title: Grave
categories.info: Visit all graves to unlock the Paying Respects trophy / achievement.

categories.title: Item Request
categories.info: Deliver 5 requested items to unlock the Errand Boy trophy / achievement. The items will spawn regardless of progression, but the gang will only request them during certain chapters.

categories.title: Legendary Animal
categories.info:
Test your hunting skills by tracking down unique wildlife. Their pelts can be traded to Trappers to unlock cosmetics and gear; animal parts can be traded to Fences for talismans.

Within the designated area, interact with all yellow clues to reveal the animal's precise location. Before searching, make sure you receive the following on-screen message: *“You have entered Legendary Animal Territory. Hunt this Legendary Animal by finding and inspecting clues”.*

categories.title: Plant
categories.info: **Tip:** Use our map's search bar to focus on specific plants by searching 'Carrot', 'Bulrush', etc.

categories.title: Point of Interest
categories.info: Points of Interest can be inspected to add them to your journal and map.

categories.title: Shack
categories.info: Approach shacks to have them added to your map like landmarks.

categories.title: Loot
categories.info: Use the map's search bar to find specific items (e.g Pamphlet, Valerian Root, Ginseng Elixir & Aged Pirate Rum!)

categories.title: Random Event
categories.info: Random events are not guaranteed to happen - and you may encounter something else entirely!

categories.title: Cheat Code
categories.info: *Cheat codes are activated in the Settings menu. They are not CasE SenSitiVe, but punctuation must be copied exactly as it appears in the quotation marks above.*
